body.name: \(F(\rho),\operatorname{Comp}_s(\rho)\)
body.construction:
Let \(s\in\{\mathrm{pub},\mathrm{CA}\}\).  Let \(\mathcal K_{\mathrm{pub}}\) be the full removed-set lattice and let \(\mathcal K_{\mathrm{CA}}=\mathcal D_G^{\mathrm{live}}\).  A prefix \(\rho=(\varnothing=A_0\to A_1\to\cdots\to A_k=A)\) is always taken in \(\mathcal K_s\), where \(A_u=A_{u-1}\cup\{r_u\}\).  Define \(F(\rho)\) by placing \(\beta(A_{u-1},r_u)\) in immutable original row slot \(r_u\), for \(u=1,\ldots,k\), and leaving all other slots unassigned.  Define
\[
 \operatorname{Comp}_s(\rho)=
 \{T_\pi:\pi\text{ is a source-to-sink path in }\mathcal K_s
 \text{ extending }\rho\}.
\]
Every permitted prefix is extendable: this is automatic in \(\mathcal K_{\mathrm{pub}}\) and follows from source-to-sink pruning in \(\mathcal K_{\mathrm{CA}}\).  The unsuperscripted convention is \(\operatorname{Comp}(\rho)=\operatorname{Comp}_{\mathrm{pub}}(\rho)\).
